gen.title: Key Facts from the Summer Meetings

cards.stem: What was debated as a chief point regarding national authority
options: how much power to allow the central government
how to create a national postal road system
how to design the national seal
cards.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government, how many representatives in Congress to allow each state
cards.hint: Think about the balance between national and state control

cards.stem: Where did the Federal Convention first meet
cards.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787, to revise the Articles of Confederation.
cards.hint: Recall the city with the State House gathering

cards.stem: What was required before the Convention could conduct business
cards.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25
cards.hint: Consider how many states had to be present
